name: New Story Editor - Update TAB behavior
description:
In the new story / edit story editor, update the hotkeys:

TAB - takes you to the next field in the current form
SHIFT + TAB - takes you to the next tab (Details, Tasks, Specs, etc)

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 2/10. Branch codex/row-37-story-tab-keys, based on origin/main. Plan: make Tab advance fields within create-editor forms, Shift+Tab advance create-editor tabs, update hints and documentation, verify create and edit behavior with agentic-tui, and run all required checks.
